title: Possible to add custom data attribute & ID in hits template root element?
body:
Hello, I'd like to put search results into a [Salvattore Masonry Grid](http://salvattore.com/) , but am having trouble getting the "data-columns" attribute & element ID added to the "ais-hits" root container. Currently I'm getting: ```html
ITEM CONTENT
``` What I need to acheive is: ```html
ITEM CONTENT
``` Is this possible? Thanks kindly!
